name: Seven Seconds Down
summary:
Seven seconds is how long it takes to reach the ground from the eightieth floor. You will find that out.

ONE HEADSET, EVERYONE PLAYING

Most of the fun is watching, so the person not wearing the headset gets a job. They hold one controller and run the session: send the rider up, end a turn at any moment, even mid fall, and show them the real room instantly if they lock up. A plate on the elevator wall tells them who is up and what to press, and a scoreboard beside it ranks the night: who went furthest, who
